name: sentinel-golden
description: 50-case deterministic golden evaluation dataset for Sentinel-RAG, built on a fictional SaaS company ('Northwind Cloud') knowledge base. See datasets/golden/README.md.

cases.question: How many days do I have to request a refund on an annual plan?

documents.title: Refund Policy
documents.text: Northwind Cloud annual subscribers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After the 30-day window, refunds are prorated based on the number of unused months remaining on the contract. Monthly subscriptions are non-refundable once a billing cycle has started.

documents.title: Office Guest WiFi
documents.text: Guests can connect to the 'Northwind-Guest' network using the password posted in the lobby. IT rotates the guest password on the first business day of each month.

cases.reference_answer: 30 days from the date of purchase.

cases.question: How much does the Growth tier cost per month?

documents.title: Pricing Tiers
documents.text: Northwind Cloud offers three tiers: Starter ($29/month, up to 5 seats), Growth ($99/month, up to 25 seats, includes SSO), and Enterprise (custom pricing, unlimited seats, includes SSO, audit logs, and a dedicated support engineer).

documents.title: Parking Policy
documents.text: Reserved parking spots are assigned by seniority and reviewed annually each January by the facilities team.

cases.reference_answer: $99 per month.

cases.question: How long are customer support ticket records kept?

documents.title: Data Retention Schedule
documents.text: Customer support ticket records, including attachments and chat transcripts, are retained for 18 months after ticket closure and then permanently purged from primary storage. Billing records are retained for 7 years to satisfy tax and audit requirements.

documents.title: Expense Reimbursement
documents.text: Employees must submit expense reports within 60 days of the purchase date to be eligible for reimbursement through the finance portal.

cases.reference_answer: 18 months after the ticket is closed.

cases.question: What encryption does Northwind Cloud use for data at rest?

documents.title: Security Overview
documents.text: Northwind Cloud encrypts customer data at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher. Access to production systems requires hardware security keys for all employees. Penetration tests are conducted quarterly by an independent third party.

documents.title: Brand Guidelines
documents.text: The Northwind Cloud logo must always appear on a white or #0B1F3A navy background, with a minimum clear space of 20px on all sides.

cases.question: What is the API rate limit for the Enterprise tier?

documents.title: API Rate Limits
documents.text: The REST API enforces a rate limit of 600 requests per minute per API key on the Growth tier and 6000 requests per minute on the Enterprise tier. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header.

documents.title: Vacation Policy
documents.text: Employees accrue 15 days of paid vacation per year, increasing to 20 days after 5 years of tenure. Unused vacation days roll over up to a maximum of 10 days into the following year.

cases.reference_answer: 6000 requests per minute per API key.

cases.question: If our uptime drops below the guarantee, do we get money back?

documents.title: Enterprise SLA (2025 edition)
documents.text: Effective January 2025, the Enterprise tier guarantees 99.95% monthly uptime. Customers receive a 15% service credit for each full percentage point of uptime below the guarantee, up to a maximum credit of 100% of that month's invoice. This edition supersedes all prior SLA documents.

documents.title: Brand Guidelines
documents.text: The Northwind Cloud logo must always appear on a white or #0B1F3A navy background, with a minimum clear space of 20px on all sides.

cases.reference_answer: Yes, a service credit of 15% of that month's invoice per full percentage point below the 99.95% uptime guarantee, up to 100%.

documents.title: Parking Policy

cases.question: If I'm on the Growth plan and want SSO, do I need Northwind's help to set it up?

documents.title: Pricing Tiers
documents.text: Northwind Cloud offers three tiers: Starter ($29/month, up to 5 seats), Growth ($99/month, up to 25 seats, includes SSO), and Enterprise (custom pricing, unlimited seats, includes SSO, audit logs, and a dedicated support engineer).

documents.title: Single Sign-On Configuration
documents.text: SSO is available on the Growth and Enterprise tiers via SAML 2.0 or OIDC. Configuring SSO requires an Enterprise onboarding engineer for initial setup on the Enterprise tier; Growth-tier customers can self-serve SSO setup from the admin console.

cases.reference_answer: No — Growth includes SSO and customers can self-serve the setup from the admin console; only Enterprise requires an onboarding engineer.

cases.question: After a Sev-1 outage, when do customers see a public update and when do they see the full writeup?

documents.title: Incident Response Process

documents.text: On March 14, 2024, a database migration error caused a 47-minute Sev-1 outage affecting all Growth and Enterprise customers in the US-East region. The root cause was a missing index that caused a lock timeout under peak load. Root cause: missing index during migration.
